question: Which of the following scientists is known as the father of the Green revolution in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.S. Swaminathan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M.S. Swaminathan** is known as the **father of the Green Revolution** in India. 
 
• M.S. Swaminathan is an Indian** geneticist and agricultural scientist **who played a crucial role in the development of **high-yielding varieties of wheat, rice**, and other crops in India.
 
• He led the Indian team that successfully implemented the **Green Revolution in the 1960s,** which helped India achieve** self-sufficiency in food production** and averted a potential famine.
 
• Swaminathan's work on **plant genetics and breeding **helped to increase crop yields and improve the quality of crops, which in turn helped to alleviate **poverty, hunger, and malnutrition** in India and other developing countries.
 
• He has received numerous awards and honors for his contributions to agriculture, including the **World Food Prize, the Padma Shri, the Padma Bhushan, and the Padma Vibhushan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Salim Ali** was an **Indian ornithologist** and **naturalist.**

 
 
• He is known as the **"Birdman of India" **for his contributions to the **study of birds **in India. 
 
 
 
• **Meghnad Saha **was an **Indian astrophysicist.**
 
 
• He is known for his work on the** thermal ionization of elements** and the **Saha equation. **
 
 
 
• **P.C. Mahalanobis **was an **Indian statistician** and **economist.**
 
 
• He is known for his work on the **Mahalanobis distance** and the development of the Indian Statistical Institute.
